voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading 1000 candles of price history, the foundation every strategy needs.
Next we add a MACD with fast 12, slow 26 and signal 9 to track momentum via EMA crossovers.
We plot the MACD line in a vivid blue so its movement is clear on the chart.
Then we overlay the signal line in the same blue to see where it meets the MACD.
Finally we draw the histogram, the difference between MACD and signal, to visualize momentum shifts.

outro.voiceover: You now see the MACD line, signal line and histogram plotted in blue, ready to backtest.
